CREATE TABLE accounts (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
    sub TEXT UNIQUE,
    name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('invited', 'active', 'suspended')),
    status_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'operator',
    status_changed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_login_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE api_keys (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    key_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    scopes TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'api',
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_used_at INTEGER,
    revoked_at INTEGER
, vault_id TEXT REFERENCES vaults(id))

CREATE TABLE ceremonies (
    key_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    document TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    client_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    registered_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_token_at INTEGER,
    document TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE codes (
    code_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
    document TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE devices (
    device_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    scopes TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    account_id TEXT,
    granted TEXT,
    interval INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_poll_at REAL
, vault_id TEXT REFERENCES vaults(id), requested_vault TEXT)

CREATE TABLE identities (
    method TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    public_key BLOB,
    sign_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_used_at INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (method, subject)
)

CREATE TABLE requests (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    document TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE sessions (
    id_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    csrf TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE tokens (
    token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    scopes TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource TEXT NOT NULL,
    issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, vault_id TEXT REFERENCES vaults(id))

CREATE TABLE vault_access (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    vault_id TEXT,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    operator TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE vault_changes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    vault_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id),
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_path TEXT,
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('created', 'updated', 'moved', 'deleted')),
    author_email TEXT NOT NULL,
    author TEXT,
    client TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    before TEXT,
    after TEXT,
    restored_from INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE vault_data_keys (
    vault_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES vaults(id),

    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rewrapped_at INTEGER

CREATE TABLE vault_invitations (
    vault_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id),
    email TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,

    link_hash TEXT,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE vault_members (
    vault_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vaults(id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (vault_id, account_id)

CREATE TABLE vault_support_grants (
    vault_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES vaults(id),
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    granted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE "vaults" (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal' CHECK (kind IN ('personal', 'shared'))
)
